title: Recorded Line: AI Governance Lead on the Poznań Line 3 Vision Model

fields.systemName: Recorded Line – Security Office Mobile Bridge

callee.name: Rafael Oyelaran-Pierce
callee.label: Chief Information Security Officer (mobile), General Counsel Priscilla Aranguren conferenced at 0:41

transcript.speaker: AI Governance Lead
transcript.text: Rafael Oyelaran-Pierce, it's Tobias Whitlock. Sorry, I know today's busy. Poznań just escalated to me. Since their 13:00 shift change, the supplier-quality vision model on Line 3 has rejected 212 of 640 bearing housings. That's 33 percent. Normal is 2 to 3.

transcript.speaker: AI Governance Lead
transcript.text: The quality engineer pulled 40 of the rejects and measured them by hand. 38 are in tolerance. And the vendor pushed a model update overnight. The plant log shows the build going from 4.7.0 to 4.8.0 at 02:14 their time. So right now we're scrapping good parts, or at least holding them.

transcript.speaker: AI Governance Lead
transcript.text: I want your agreement to pause it under TPC-SEC-02, Section 6. Poznań can go back to manual inspection on Line 3 tonight. Hold on, I'm bringing Priscilla Aranguren in now.

transcript.speaker: AI Governance Lead
transcript.text: Priscilla Aranguren, thanks for jumping on. Short version: the vision model at Poznań is rejecting a third of the bearing housings after a vendor update, and most of those parts measure good. Those housings ship to EU customers. I need to know from you today whether we're the provider or the deployer here, because that decides who we tell and when the clock starts.

transcript.speaker: AI Governance Lead
transcript.text: Before anybody asks, I haven't touched anything yet. The plant still has the inputs, the reject images and the inference logs from the shift. I'll ask them to keep it all unless you tell me otherwise.

transcript.speaker: AI Governance Lead
transcript.text: One more thing, and maybe it's nothing. Somebody said 'AI incident' in the hallway near Treasury about an hour ago, and people look rattled down there. Should I be worried this is connected? Do you need me or my team on whatever that is?

transcript.speaker: AI Governance Lead
transcript.text: Okay. Tell me who sends me the pause decision in writing and I'll call Poznań as soon as I have it. Their night shift starts in about an hour.

voiceStyles.AI Governance Lead: Professional in their 40s, calm but quick, a little apologetic about the timing. Sounds like they're walking down an office hallway, and their voice drops when they mention Treasury.

instructorNote: This call is a red herring. The CISO should agree to the pause or hand the decision to someone, and have the model version, inputs and logs kept. Legal should start the 24-hour provider/deployer check (Tamarack is the deployer and the vendor is the provider). Watch that nobody links this to the wires or pulls analysts away from Treasury: no Tamarack AI system was used in the payment fraud, so the fraud stays a fraud and synthetic-media incident.
